Package com.mimecast.robin.config.server

Class EmailAnalysisBotConfig

java.lang.Object
com.mimecast.robin.config.server.EmailAnalysisBotConfig
public class EmailAnalysisBotConfig extends Object
Typed configuration wrapper for the email analysis bot.

All settings are read from the bot definition map in bots.json5 and have sensible defaults so any omitted key behaves as if it were enabled.
